name: Inflow Spike
rule: Flagged when an NGO's total foreign inflow in a financial year is at least 3 times its total in the previous financial year.

name: Donor Concentration
rule: Flagged when a single foreign donor accounts for 80% or more of an NGO's total foreign inflow in one financial year.

name: Dormant Revival
rule: Flagged when an NGO filed NIL (zero foreign contribution) in the previous financial year and receives at least Rs. 50 lakh in the current financial year.
